Correct language routing in mixed code and labels such as 5G, and avoid unnecessary pauses around numbers.
Improve voice downloads, previews and narrator selection. Filters show installed voices.
Bundle Chinese and English; add Japanese, German or French from More. Reduce the installer by about 34 MB.
Fade scene effects more gradually and add seven sound packs.
Add Check for updates to User, with release notes, background downloads and cancellation.
